question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Vicinity
solution: The correct answer is **"Remote."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Vicinity"** means a surrounding area or a nearby location. (आसपास का क्षेत्र या निकटवर्ती स्थान) • **Example**: *The number of people living in the immediate **vicinity**__ was small.* • The antonym of **vicinity** is **"remote."** • **"Remote"** means far away from where other people live. ((किसी स्‍थान से) बहुत दूर, दूरवर्ती) __ • **Example**: *She lives in a **remote**__ island.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Natural"** means something that is existing in nature or is not man-made. (प्रकृति में विद्यमान, प्राकृतिक, मानव-प्रेरित या निर्मित नहीं; नैसर्गिक) • **"Adjacent"** means something that is next to or adjoining something else. (किसी के निकट या बग़ल में स्थित; आसन्‍न) • **"Proximity"** means being close in space or time. ((स्‍थान और समय की दृष्टि से) निकटता) 36:T639, The correct answer is **"referred to one particular."**
